name: Fan-out branch diagram
looks: One source block sits on the left; thin curved lines draw out from it to a column of labelled endpoint chips on the right, each a different accent colour, arriving on a stagger. The shot closes on a short checklist: green checks for what stays fair or constant, a red cross for the one thing never done.
build: The source is a DOM/code panel. Each branch is an SVG bezier path revealed with strokeDashoffset, staggered 0.08-0.12s apart; each endpoint chip fades/scales in as its line arrives, coloured to match. The checklist rows reveal beneath on their own short stagger after the last branch lands.
sound: A soft whoosh per branch line, a tick on each chip's arrival, and one lower tone on the checklist's cross item.
prompt: Show one input reaching several parallel recipients under the same rules: draw branching lines from a single source block out to a column of labelled endpoints, arriving on a stagger, then close on a short checklist proving what stayed fair and what was never done.
source: an AI Arena product promo in prompt-motion.com's gallery (prompt-motion.com/ezshine-c90d73), studied 2026-10-09
